entry.name: SKEENA RIVER (mainstem only)
entry.regs_verbatim:
**There are two separate Class II waters on the Skeena River** (non-residents and non-resident aliens require separate licences describing
which section they are fishing): **(a)** from Exchamsiks River to 1.5 km upstream of Kitsumkalum River (known as "Skeena River 2"), July 1-Sept 30; and **(b)** 1.5 km upstream of Zymoetz River (known as "Skeena River Section 4"), July 1-Dec 31; **Steelhead Stamp** not mandatory for
Skeena River 2 unless fishing for steelhead. **Steelhead Stamp** is mandatory in Skeena River Section 4 during the Classified Waters period
from July 1-Dec 31
**Angling prohibited for non-guided non-resident aliens** in Skeena River Section 4 on Saturdays and Sundays in two zones: **(a)** Shegunia
River confluence to Sedan Creek confluence July 1-Dec 31 (See map page 54), and **(b)** Chimdemash Creek confluence to 1.5 km upstream of
Zymoetz River confluence, July 1 - Dec 31, (See map page 55)

rules.verbatim: Angling prohibited for non-guided non-resident aliens in Skeena River Section 4 on Saturdays and Sundays in two zones: (a) Shegunia River confluence to Sedan Creek confluence July 1-Dec 31 (See map page 54)
Chimdemash Creek confluence to 1.5 km upstream of Zymoetz River confluence, July 1 - Dec 31, (See map page 55)

steelhead_stamp_waived.verbatim: Steelhead Stamp not mandatory for Skeena River 2 unless fishing for steelhead.

licensing.verbatim: There are two separate Class II waters on the Skeena River (non-residents and non-resident aliens require separate licences describing which section they are fishing): (a) from Exchamsiks River to 1.5 km upstream of Kitsumkalum River (known as "Skeena River 2"), July 1-Sept 30
licensing.review_reason: From the Exchamsiks confluence cut (owner 2026-10-24, book p.53: from Exchamsiks River to 1.5 km upstream of Kitsumkalum River). T67 put that cut on the mainstem (360887278 at 67,917 m); before it the cut lay only on side channel 360216952 and the reach stood in at the Skeena River Ecological Reserve's lower mainstem crossing (m 63,480, LS-1), over-requiring the licence below the Exchamsiks.

steelhead_stamp_during.verbatim: Steelhead Stamp is mandatory in Skeena River Section 4 during the Classified Waters period from July 1-Dec 31

licensing.verbatim: 1.5 km upstream of Zymoetz River (known as "Skeena River Section 4"), July 1-Dec 31
licensing.review_reason: Skeena River Section 4 prints only its lower end (1.5 km upstream of Zymoetz River); bound upstream_of that point with no upper end, which runs to the headwaters — a curator must draw the upper bound from the page 54/55 maps
